title: A callback with a state that does not match a pending flow is refused
asA: operator whose browser has been redirected to the callback endpoint with a state value the project's pending-flow store never issued
iWant: the callback to be refused before any token exchange
soThat: an attacker who guesses or replays a state value cannot force the project to redeem a code they control

acceptanceCriteria.description: A callback whose state value has no corresponding pending-flow record is refused with a stable-coded response and no token-exchange call.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pending-flow store is empty and a request is dispatched to the callback route with `state=<random-value>&code=<random-value>`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_STATE_UNKNOWN`; the mock provider's `tokenUrl` records zero request attempts for this state value; no session cookie is set on the response

acceptanceCriteria.description: A callback that presents a state value from a pending flow already consumed on a prior successful exchange is refused with the same shape.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful flow from US-10101 has consumed state value `s1`
acceptanceCriteria.when: a subsequent callback request is dispatched with the same `state=s1` value
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_STATE_ALREADY_CONSUMED`; the mock provider's `tokenUrl` records zero new request attempts for this state; no session cookie is set on the response

acceptanceCriteria.description: A callback whose state maps to a pending-flow record older than the configured TTL is refused with a stable-coded response.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a pending-flow record for state `s2` was minted `pendingFlowTtlSeconds + 60` seconds before the callback (simulated by advancing the flow-controller's clock through the test-injected clock port)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_STATE_EXPIRED`; the pending-flow record has been evicted from the store; no session cookie is set on the response
